about: Scenes for the animated video of The Feature Fallacy. Each scene starts at a phrase in the narration ("at"); keys ending in At name phrases that trigger a move inside the scene. Chapter cards are added by render.mjs. The example's figures are from the article (illustrative).

scenes.at: If you measure progress by how many features ship
scenes.text: If you measure progress by how many features ship, you'll eventually ship yourself into irrelevance.

scenes.at: the teams that win aren't the ones
scenes.label: The teams that win
items: the shortest path to an outcome

scenes.label: Value density
scenes.note: When it goes up, adoption, retention and trust follow.

scenes.label: Three invisible taxes you're probably paying
cards: Every feature branches the mental model. Users pay in cognitive load; teams in QA, docs and support.
Features don't adopt themselves. Shipping without an adoption path is just inventory.
More surface, more edge cases. In healthcare, quality debt compounds with safety risk.

scenes.label: A better north star: OEM
items: observable, e.g. median prescription time from 4:30 to 2:00
a falsifiable hypothesis and a measurement plan
the smallest intervention for a narrow segment, then scale

scenes.label: What to do this quarter
items: Measure the path, not the page

scenes.at: Clinicians were abandoning an Orders flow
scenes.label: An example (illustrative)
scenes.text: Clinicians were abandoning the Orders flow. The instinct: build “Orders 2.0”.

scenes.label: The OEM approach
items: replays showed friction in context switching and code search
auto-attach context, pre-fill three likely codes, keyboard search

scenes.label: How Product and Engineering win together
cards: The fewest interventions that move the outcome. Owns the problem and the kill criteria.
Collapse time to learning: instrument, ship behind flags, treat reliability as user value.
What did we learn? What can we ship next week to learn faster?

scenes.label: The courage to delete
scenes.text: Remove underused features, consolidate patterns, redesign flows that need explaining.

scenes.at: run OEM on a single critical path
scenes.label: The ask: one critical path, this month
